estate_label: Intellectual property, standards, and data-rights estate
domain: patents, assignments, trademarks, licenses, standards, technical baselines, government data rights, and interface control
scope: Patents, patent assignments, trademarks, licenses, standards participation, technical data and software rights, government-purpose and unlimited-rights clauses, interface control documents, reference architectures, interoperability obligations, and substitution rights. The estate separates invention, ownership, license, standard, contract clause, implementation, and control.
why_new_estate: Anduril and other stack-control investigations repeatedly turn on data rights, interfaces, and substitution, while research and capital estates need assignment and licensing chronology.

denominator_contract.unit: one patent family, trademark, assignment, license, standard, contract rights schedule, interface-control document, or technical baseline
denominator_contract.inclusion_rule: Official patent, assignment, trademark, standards, procurement, protest, corporate filing, and contract-rights records.
denominator_contract.exclusion_rule: Patent citations as licenses; marketing use of a standard as compliance; contract award as proof of government data rights.
denominator_contract.time_window: historical through 2026-07-23, with each source query recording its own bounded window
required_null_controls: contract with no located rights schedule

source_routes.bounded_output: Patent applications, patents, inventors, applicants, prosecution history, status, documents, and bulk/open-data identifiers.
source_routes.residual_fog: Applicant, assignee, inventor, beneficial owner, licensee, and implementing company are distinct; unpublished applications remain unavailable.

source_routes.bounded_output: Recorded patent and trademark assignment documents with assignor, assignee, reel/frame or conveyance identifiers, and execution dates.
source_routes.residual_fog: Recording is voluntary and does not validate the underlying transaction; unrecorded licenses and beneficial ownership remain.

source_routes.bounded_output: Trademark applications and registrations, owners, assignments, goods/services, prosecution, status, and event history.
source_routes.residual_fog: Trademark ownership does not establish corporate control, product deployment, patent ownership, or licensing.

source_routes.bounded_output: Public standards, government standards policy, participation, drafts, final versions, reference architectures, and implementation guidance where available.
source_routes.residual_fog: Many standards are copyrighted or membership-gated; participation does not establish authorship, adoption, implementation, or control.

source_routes.bounded_output: Contract opportunities, award notices, solicitation identifiers, and contracting data.
source_routes.residual_fog: Some APIs require a key; attachments, amendments, interested vendors, and source-selection files may require additional acquisition.

source_routes.bounded_output: Bid-protest docket, outcome, decision, solicitation, agency, and public decision documents.
source_routes.residual_fog: Routine dismissals and protected filings are not always public; FOIA may be required for decided-case records.

source_routes.bounded_output: CIKs, accession numbers, filing types, Form D offerings, ownership, merger, and company filings.
source_routes.residual_fog: CIK resolution, filer/entity boundaries, amended filings, and governance-right extraction require estate-specific parsing.

decisive_output: asset- and instrument-level ledger of inventors, assignees, assignments, licenses, standards role, government rights, interface control, implementation, and expiration or abandonment
next_acquisition: join inventions, assignments, licenses, standards, contract clauses, interface baselines, and substitution rights
boundaries: A patent, assignment, standard contribution, license, contract clause, and practical control of an interface are different facts. Citation or standards participation does not establish ownership or adoption.
A surveyed and prepared estate is not an acquired, completed, or finding-bearing estate.
Official source availability is not evidence of a subject overlap.
